Career.Name: Syndicate
Career.Description: The Syndicate is the catch-all for anyone belonging to a criminal syndicate, whether that is a ruthless street brawler gang controlling turf, an empire of spicers and slavers, or even a clandestine order of assassins for hire. [P][B]What are the 3 pillars of the Career?[b] [P]Social Subterfuge & Dominance [P]Enterprise [P]Underworld Mastery
